name: Batch Resize Image
description: Batch-resizes images in the files folder.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Why and when should you use this module? 
 Sometimes after you have build the website, you may have many files already uploaded. You may forget to limit max image resolution before site online, images are original format and they may be very large.

In this case, you can use this module to check every file and re-size then as the size you want.

 Back to top 

 !!Attention!! 
 BACKUP files first! . This module will change your image files and database permanently .

 This module will scan file_managed table, and only transform image file(by extension check). You should back up sites/default/files folder to prevent something go wrong.
